text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of graduate college Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of graduate college 5. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 4 or above 6. Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of physical examination record.
